payload.library_title_zh: Portrait Visual OS · V5.16.1 Parity Restoration

global_rules.value: Do not copy readable text, logos, brand names or trademarked graphics from the references. Generate typography-safe base images; accurate Chinese typography remains a post-layout task.
Reference images define visual grammar, not literal character identity, wardrobe, product branding or scene replication.
All routes should end with the shared instruction: preserve the uploaded subject's identity to the maximum extent compatible with the selected visual translation; do the best work you can.
zh-CN
en

value.rule: 风格 Prompt 不得硬编码“最大程度保留人物面部特征”。由控制台根据用户选择动态注入 {{FACE_MODE_INSTRUCTION}}，避免与 5 档面部处理强度冲突。

levels.1: 全量保留：真实身份、年龄、自然表情与主要面部比例均保持稳定，仅允许光影和皮肤质感统一。
levels.2: 稍微柔化：身份明显可辨，允许轻微磨皮、胶片化和局部柔化。
levels.3: 轻度平面化：保留大部分识别特征，允许半调、拼贴、插画化或印刷质感。
levels.4: 中度平面化：保留脸型、眼神、眉眼关系、发型和标志性特征，允许较明显图形化处理。
levels.5: 全部平面化：仅保留最明显的人物识别线索，用于插画、剪纸、版画或强视觉实验。

value.rule: 默认允许重构服装，使人物与场景、年代和视觉主题融合。只有用户主动选择“保留原服装”时才复用原片穿搭。
生图模型优先完成底图、留白和装饰性文字纹理；精确中文标题、日期、标签和副文案由后期排版层写入。不得要求模型准确生成大量可读文字。
value.face_safe_zone: 所有标题、标签、条形码、边框、色块和装饰线不得遮挡人物眼睛、鼻梁、嘴部及完整面部识别区域。可以与发丝、肩部、服装和背景发生层叠关系。

global_rules.value: 人物、服装、光影、色彩、颗粒和背景必须属于同一个视觉世界，禁止将原片人物像贴纸一样直接放进新背景。
真实品牌、明星姓名、影视标题和商标只作为视觉参考，不在正式模板中复刻；使用虚构刊名、虚构品牌和可替换占位文本。
本批采用补丁式入库：只有视觉机制显著不同、能够形成独立用户选择价值的路线才新增节点；其余全部作为既有节点变体扩展。

value.default: 所有文字、色块、边框、裁切框、标签和装饰线不得覆盖眼睛、鼻梁、嘴部以及完整面部识别区域。
value.adaptation_rule: 当参考图依赖遮眼色带、横向文字或眼部裁切框时，不直接复制遮脸动作。将色带移动到额头上方、人物背后或画面边缘；将眼部裁切框改为独立副图框，放置在面部外侧。
value.reason: 保留参考图的设计语法，同时满足面部识别稳定性和大众用户接受度。

global_rules.value: 风格 Prompt 不写死“最大程度保留人物面部特征”。继续通过 {{FACE_MODE_INSTRUCTION}} 动态注入五档处理强度，避免平面化模式与身份保留约束相互冲突。
默认根据风格重构服装、妆发和配饰，使人物与环境融合。仅在用户主动选择保留原服装时复用原片穿搭。
模型优先生成底图、留白区与装饰性文字纹理。精确中文标题、日期、栏目名和副文案交给后期排版层写入。
参考图中的品牌、刊名、艺人姓名和商标只用于理解视觉机制；正式模板统一使用虚构名称或可替换占位文本。
第四批继续执行补丁式入库。用户侧只增加能够带来清晰选择差异的风格按钮；构图、道具、色彩和信息层变化优先沉淀为既有节点变体。

value.default: 所有普通商业模板至少保留一处完整、清晰、无遮挡的主体面部。
value.opt_in_exception: 碎镜、多重眼神、编辑器裁切框等实验性模板允许重复或局部裁切面部，但必须保留至少一处可识别的完整主脸。此类模板默认标记 experimental，不作为首次使用推荐。
value.reason: 区分大众可用模板与实验视觉，避免将高冲击力设计误当作所有用户的默认生成逻辑。

global_rules.value: 日系周刊、平成少女刊和体育漫画刊允许密集文字墙，但模型生成阶段只负责伪文字纹理、排版区块与留白。准确标题、日期、栏目与用户文案继续由后期排版层写入。
不得复制 ELLE、Popteen、mina、Netflix 等真实品牌、刊名、角色名和商标。统一生成虚构刊名、可替换栏目和抽象贴纸。
明显属于普通原片、实验记录或误传照片的内容不得直接入库为风格节点，可单独登记为未来压力测试素材。
从第五批开始，新增内容必须先判断属于风格路线、场景预设、构图模块、字体套件、光影预设还是节点内部变体。
商业模板默认保留至少一处完整、清晰、无遮挡的主体面部。选择框、弹窗卡片、手势和巨型文字不得压住关键五官。
抓娃娃机、水族箱、旧街、森林公路等环境必须与人物共同生成，不得把人物简单粘贴在背景图上。
产品快闪广告模块只生成虚构品牌、可替换产品和排版安全区，不复制真实品牌、产品型号、商标或活动信息。
所有旧刊、唱片刊和海报模板只生成伪文字纹理、栏目区块和留白。准确标题、日期、城市、票务信息与中文文案由后期排版层写入。
模块可以声明适配风格，但不得反向污染顶层风格分类。例如手机跃出、票券弹窗和手势框景应作为构图模块，而不是各自新增一个完整风格按钮。
素材库进入首轮冻结。后续新增顶层路线必须满足：在材质、叙事世界、人物融合方式和信息层组织上至少有两项明显差异；否则优先归入变体或模块。
涉及别针、金属夹、玻璃碎裂或其他锐利视觉元素时，只能作为悬浮、贴纸、印刷叠层或与皮肤保持距离的造型道具，不表现穿刺、伤口或危险接触。
商业模板至少保留一处完整可识别面部。头盔、玻璃、贴纸、文字、动漫头像和 UI 元素不得覆盖双眼、鼻部与嘴部的关键识别区域。
动漫头像与像素头像只作为辅助贴纸或副图。主角仍为真实人物，不把主体直接替换为动画角色。
旧刊、杂志、地下刊和情书海报只生成伪文字区块与排版安全区。准确日期、品牌、标题、中文文案、活动信息与签名统一交给后期排版层。
数码拼贴和商业模板使用虚构品牌、抽象设备和通用图标，不复制真实商标、真实角色、产品型号或活动信息。
应用批次 01 至 06 时必须按顺序导入。批次 05 与 06 引入组件化层级，构建导演台时应把旧节点映射到新的分层结构。
Graduation-season screenshots are archived visual references used to extract reusable staging grammar, not identity references, not school-brand assets, and not redistributable product media.
Do not reproduce readable university crests, school names, diploma text, watermarks, or institutional logos. Use generic academic regalia and fictional or non-readable insignia only.
Do not turn every sample into a style route. Consolidate the batch into four routes and reusable scenes, wardrobe, props, lighting presets, action blueprints, compositions, and layout modules.
Generate a clean typography-aware base image. Accurate graduate name, school, major, date, and Class Of text belong to Layout Studio SVG/HTML overlays.
Mature-women screenshots are archived visual references used to extract reusable portrait grammar, not identity references and not redistributable product media.
Consolidate mature-women references into a small set of commercial portrait routes plus reusable scenes, wardrobe, lighting, actions, and layouts. Do not create one route per screenshot.
The lecture-hall and classroom-window images strengthen graduation-campus-memory-film as components and templates; they do not become redundant new routes.
Opaque or mirrored sunglasses must fully hide both eyes. Never render sharp pupils, irises, eyelashes, duplicate eyes, or floating eye details through dark lenses.
Translucent tinted lenses may imply aligned eyes only as soft low-contrast forms subordinate to the lens tint and surface reflection. Never render sharp through-lens pupils or mismatched gaze.
When identity fidelity is critical, prefer no sunglasses, lifted sunglasses, or sunglasses held in one hand. Do not preserve an accessory at the cost of uncanny eyes.

global_rules.summary: 光线必须有一个主导来源，其他光仅作为环境填充或反射。
global_rules.instruction_en: Use one dominant key-light logic and keep other emitters subordinate.

global_rules.summary: 高光、阴影、轮廓光、反射和投影方向必须与光源几何一致。
global_rules.instruction_en: Keep highlight, shadow, rim light, reflection, and cast-shadow direction physically consistent.

global_rules.summary: 保护额头、鼻梁、脸颊、肩部、白衣与珠宝高光，不允许大面积死白。
global_rules.instruction_en: Protect highlight roll-off on skin, white fabric, satin, pearls, and glossy surfaces.

global_rules.summary: 人物角度必须与光线方向匹配，避免正面、侧面、背光逻辑互相冲突。
global_rules.instruction_en: Adapt face angle and pose to the key light so facial planes remain believable.

global_rules.summary: 硬窗光、百叶、手部和叶影的投影必须沿连续表面保持统一方向、尺度与虚实。
global_rules.instruction_en: Keep structured hard-shadow bands connected across wall, skin, clothing, and furniture with one source path.

global_rules.summary: 相机直闪必须体现近镜头光源、前景优先、快速衰减和短硬投影。
global_rules.instruction_en: Use near-lens direct-flash geometry with inverse-square foreground priority and short hard cast shadows.

global_rules.summary: 使用直闪时不得同时凭空加入电影式轮廓光。
global_rules.instruction_en: Do not combine direct-flash flattening with unrelated cinematic rim lights unless a visible practical explains them.

global_rules.summary: 透明眼镜后的双眼必须自然可读、对齐，镜片反射不得吞掉身份信息。
global_rules.instruction_en: Keep eyes readable and aligned behind transparent prescription lenses; reduce reflections before sacrificing identity.

global_rules.summary: 透明镜片上的闪光反射必须克制且与相机位置一致。
global_rules.instruction_en: Allow only restrained camera-position-consistent glints on clear lenses; forbid giant white blobs, warped eyes, and detached frames.

global_rules.summary: 窄束光、门缝光、投影光斑和前景遮挡必须沿统一孔径路径保持方向、边缘与衰减连续。
global_rules.instruction_en: Keep occluded beams attached to one aperture path with coherent edge softness, surface continuity, and falloff.

global_rules.summary: 低照度与大面积阴影不应牺牲关键面部识别区。
global_rules.instruction_en: Preserve readable facial landmarks inside low-key scenes even when most of the frame remains dark.

global_rules.summary: 黄昏直闪必须区分近距离闪光前景与远距离天空、海面和地平线环境光。
global_rules.instruction_en: Separate near-lens flash exposure from distant dusk ambient; do not light horizon-scale backgrounds as if they sit at portrait distance.

global_rules.summary: 蓝调屋顶可同时存在暖色侧逆光与克制前补光，但二者职责必须清晰分离。
global_rules.instruction_en: Allow rear-side warm rim and restrained front fill only when their emitter roles remain visibly separable.

global_rules.summary: 玻璃、窗面与前景柔焦必须作为有深度的光学平面，而非漂浮贴图。
global_rules.instruction_en: Keep reflections, foreground veils, and glass layers plane-bound, depth-aware, and subordinate to the subject.

global_rules.summary: 轮廓光和光斑高光必须保留发丝、皮肤与浅色衣物的渐变，不可直接烧白。
global_rules.instruction_en: Protect highlight roll-off on hair, skin, pale coats, white dresses, and bedding; avoid clipped halo edges.

global_rules.summary: 风动发丝必须服从一个主导风向，并在脸部形成可解释的遮挡和阴影。
global_rules.instruction_en: Keep wind-led hair strands aligned to one dominant vector; preserve readable eyes, nose bridge, and mouth while keeping strand shadows attached to the same source direction.

global_rules.summary: 手部进入窄束光时，手指受光、投影与脸部光斑必须连续且方向一致。
global_rules.instruction_en: When a hand intercepts a warm beam, keep lit fingers, cast shadow, face patch, and penumbra attached to one source path.

global_rules.summary: 黄金时刻眩光、发丝轮廓光和镜头炫光必须与低太阳轴线一致。
global_rules.instruction_en: Align golden-hour flare artifacts, warm rim, bloom, and hair highlights with one low-sun lens axis; reject decorative floating orbs.

global_rules.summary: 慢门拖影必须区分人物运动方向、相机摇摄方向和背景光轨方向。
global_rules.instruction_en: Separate subject motion, camera panning, and background streak direction; keep them coherent rather than smearing every layer equally.

global_rules.summary: 拖影肖像仍需保留至少一个可识别锚点，例如眼部轮廓、嘴唇、肩线或发型剪影。
global_rules.instruction_en: Preserve at least one readable identity anchor in motion-blur portraits while allowing intentional softness elsewhere.

global_rules.summary: 卧室暖窗光必须遵守窗户位置、墙面反射、床品与道具的局部回弹关系。
global_rules.instruction_en: Keep bedroom window light attached to the visible window direction with plausible textile, wall, desk, and skin bounce.

global_rules.summary: 拖影照片中的文字属于后期排版层，不应随人物与背景一起被模糊。
global_rules.instruction_en: Treat editorial typography as a post-layout layer: keep it crisp, sparse, and outside recognition landmarks even when the image layer is blurred.

global_rules.summary: 围巾、衣领和面部必须保持清晰体积关系，不能粘连成一块。
global_rules.instruction_en: Preserve scarf volume, layered folds, jaw separation, and low-sun edge response; reject scarf textures fused into skin or hair.

global_rules.summary: 林间柔光必须同时服从树冠透光、叶片层次与人物轮廓光。
global_rules.instruction_en: Keep canopy transmission, leaf bokeh, hair rim, dress highlights, and background depth subordinate to one forest daylight field.

global_rules.summary: 飘落叶片必须遵守景深、重力与风向层级。
global_rules.instruction_en: Keep foreground, midground, and background leaves on one plausible gravity-and-breeze field with depth-scaled blur and no decorative sticker scatter.

global_rules.summary: 车窗或室内窗边的红绿实景光必须与人物主光分离。
global_rules.instruction_en: Separate warm side sun, colored practical reflections, dark cabin shadow, and window-plane flare; reject arbitrary neon stains on skin.

global_rules.summary: 花冠、花枝、花瓣与衣物必须具有可解释的附着关系。
global_rules.instruction_en: Keep baby-breath stems, flower-eye occluders, coat flowers, and scarf layers physically attached and anatomically safe; reject flowers sprouting from skin or floating without support.

global_rules.summary: 通勤车厢必须保持透视、窗光与人物站位一致。
global_rules.instruction_en: Align corridor vanishing lines, window light, reflective metal surfaces, scarf volume, and subject position; reject warped cabins and floating doors.

global_rules.summary: 窗面反射必须区分人物实体、玻璃平面和反射幽影。
global_rules.instruction_en: Keep the physical subject, glass plane, reflected ghost, and background highlights separable with one plausible offset; reject duplicated facial anatomy masquerading as reflection.

global_rules.summary: 先确定相机位置和透视类型，再叠加风格、服装和排版。
global_rules.instruction_en: Resolve camera height, lens behavior, horizon, and vanishing logic before style embellishment.

global_rules.summary: 人物、前景遮挡、道具、背景结构、光线投影和文字排版属于不同平面。
global_rules.instruction_en: Keep subject, foreground occlusion, props, background geometry, light projection, and typography overlays on distinct coherent planes.

global_rules.summary: 前景虚化必须有真实物体来源，不能成为随意遮脸的模糊块。
global_rules.instruction_en: Allow foreground blur only when it belongs to a plausible branch, glass, newspaper, flower, table edge, or architectural plane.

global_rules.summary: 栏杆、车辆、走廊、窗框、桌面、台阶和地平线必须服从同一套透视关系。
global_rules.instruction_en: Keep railings, vehicle panels, corridors, windows, tables, steps, and horizons subordinate to one coherent projection logic.

global_rules.summary: 地平线和建筑边缘不得粗暴切割眼睛、嘴唇和下颌。
global_rules.instruction_en: Place horizon and architectural edges outside recognition landmarks unless an intentional reviewed crop requires otherwise.

global_rules.summary: 窄束光、叶影与窗框影必须能够回溯到真实遮挡物和入射方向。
global_rules.instruction_en: Trace hard beam and botanical shadow projections to an inferable aperture, branch, or window direction.

global_rules.summary: 文字属于后期排版层，应保持清晰并避让人物识别锚点。
global_rules.instruction_en: Treat typography as a crisp post-layout plane. Reserve negative space and avoid facial landmarks, hand anatomy, props, and key silhouette edges.

global_rules.summary: 夸张缩短透视必须保留肢体连续性，不能出现断腿、漂浮鞋和随机放大。
global_rules.instruction_en: Allow editorial foreshortening only with readable limb continuity, grounded contact, and one camera-origin explanation.

global_rules.summary: 工作台离线读取内嵌兜底库，在线同目录读取独立主库，两条路径必须语义一致。
global_rules.instruction_en: Keep embedded offline fallback semantically identical to the hosted canonical JSON and verify both paths before release.

migration.strategy: Preserve the V3 UI and legacy routes, migrate all styles into one runtime schema, and add compatible modular presets from the compiled JSON library.

v5_meta.architecture: D · Cinematic Studio main workbench + Museum Archive / Editorial Atelier Asset Library
v5_meta.primary_archive_rule: 一级目录按照人物使用范围组织：男、女、通用、结婚。V4 原始视觉家族下沉为二级目录；具体路线作为二级目录内的可调用节点。
v5_meta.typography_policy: Typography kits are components and hybrid recipe ingredients, not isolated route buttons. Accurate text is applied in the later HTML/SVG layout layer.
v5_meta.roadmap_policy: Roadmap, material gaps, and authorization-verification notes are separated from the formal console.

v5_5_meta.title: Single Portrait Motion Grammar + Typography Interaction
v5_5_meta.archived_reference_role: composition, pose, gaze, typography interaction extraction only; never identity_reference
v5_5_meta.prompt_default: clean editorial base image without actual readable typography

v5_7_meta.title: V5.6 Baseline + Single Portrait Motion Grammar + Typography Interaction
v5_7_meta.baseline: Portrait Visual OS V5.6.0 Composition Hygiene + Typography Placement + Local JSON Bridge
v5_7_meta.default_base_image_policy: Generate a clean typography-aware base image. Exact readable typography belongs to Layout Studio SVG/HTML overlays.
v5_7_meta.archived_reference_role: extract composition, pose, expression, gaze and typography interaction only; never identity_reference

v5_8_meta.title: Quality Calibration & Constraint Resolver
v5_8_meta.default_policy: Prioritize clean, readable, anatomically plausible portrait staging. Auto-downgrade high-risk combinations before prompt export.

product_release.name: Portrait Visual OS · V6.1.1 Poster Structure Runtime
product_release.entry_model: task-preset -> visual-route -> text-participation-strategy -> user-copy -> prompt-copy-cta -> generation -> layout-studio -> exact-correction -> output-png
product_release.primary_goal: 在封板 Visual Core 5.16.1 基础上，以 GPT 提示词为相对完善的主线（豆包线为测试版本），补齐无字海报骨架策略、可选版式模板参考角色，并保持准确文字可由排版工作区后期校正。

provider_maturity.note_zh: GPT 提示词为当前唯一相对完善的主线；豆包线为测试版本，欢迎试用但不要作为唯一交付路径。

library_contract.html_runtime_role: Hosted UI loads compiled canonical JSON first. Manifest modules remain an auditable fallback. file:// uses embedded fallback.
library_contract.incremental_extension_role: Local bundle JSON files append or update assets without editing the HTML source.
library_contract.workspace_export_role: Generation configuration JSON remains separate from the canonical asset library.
library_contract.ui_disclosure_policy: First view shows task preset, visual route, compact generation intent and prompt. Route archive, component tuning, diagnostics and engineering tools remain available on demand.
library_contract.graduation_domain_role: Graduation routes live as a curated domain extension: routes stay few, components and action grammar stay reusable.
library_contract.accessory_occlusion_policy_role: Opaque eyewear must hide eyes cleanly; translucent lenses must not render sharp duplicate pupils; accessory safety is compiled globally and reinforced at route level.
library_contract.lighting_physics_role: Lighting presets carry explicit source geometry, temperature, hardness, falloff, shadow, reflection, catchlight, exposure, and pose-angle compatibility. Prompt compilation adds global physical-coherence constraints.
library_contract.clear_lens_flash_role: Clear prescription lenses remain transparent optical surfaces with readable aligned eyes, restrained reflections, coherent frame geometry, and direct-flash reflection control.
library_contract.structured_shadow_role: Hard sunlight and occluder patterns must preserve a single source path, connected cast-shadow geometry, realistic penumbra, and readable facial landmarks.
library_contract.occluded_beam_role: Narrow warm beams, spot pools, foreground veils, and occluder shadows must follow one physical aperture path with coherent edge softness, falloff, exposure, and facial landmark readability.
library_contract.twilight_flash_role: Dusk direct flash and rooftop rim-fill scenes must separate foreground flash, rear-side sunset rim, and low ambient sky exposure without inventing extra unmotivated emitters.
library_contract.wind_hair_occlusion_role: Wind-led hair may cross the face only as one directional field with readable recognition anchors, source-consistent strand shadows, and no detached hair veil pasted over anatomy.
library_contract.intentional_motion_blur_role: Panning and slow-shutter portraits must separate subject blur, background streak direction, post-layout typography sharpness, and at least one identity anchor.
library_contract.goldenhour_flare_role: Lens flare, warm rim, and backlight bloom must align with one low-sun axis and retain highlight roll-off on hair, skin, clothing, and sky.
library_contract.bedroom_lifestyle_role: Bedroom and window-corner lifestyle scenes must preserve one natural window direction, local wall or textile bounce, readable props, and uncluttered facial space.
library_contract.seasonal_sunlight_role: Winter scarf, forest canopy, and autumn leaf scenes preserve fabric volume, canopy transmission, gravity-led depth, and readable facial anchors.
library_contract.floral_attachment_role: Floral halo routes require visible or inferable stem attachment, one readable eye when occluded, and material separation across petals, scarf, denim, hair, and skin.
library_contract.transit_reflection_role: Transit and reflective-window routes preserve corridor perspective, window direction, glass-plane offsets, and physical-subject priority.
library_contract.composition_perspective_role: camera position, projection family, plane separation, foreground occlusion, architecture geometry, horizon logic, and typography safe zones
library_contract.editorial_typography_plane_role: exact text remains a post-layout responsibility; image generation reserves legible negative-space zones and never burns fragile text into identity landmarks
library_contract.runtime_file_access_role: HTTP(S): compiled canonical JSON -> manifest modules -> embedded fallback. file://: embedded fallback.
library_contract.runtime_module_role: Interactive runtime loads only operational modules. Historical extraction catalogs remain optional lazy modules.
library_contract.schema_contract_role: Schema version is stable and independent from content release version. Release metadata is tracked separately.
library_contract.font_reference_role: User-uploaded font specimen screenshots enter a reference-only layer with visual-family classification and verified proxy mapping. They are never treated as redistributable font binaries or directly applicable font assets.
library_contract.font_asset_role: Only verified open-source metadata records with official source URLs and CSS API family parameters enter the directly applicable font_assets layer.

architecture_hardening.principle: 风格路线摄入继续冻结。字体扩展保持三层架构：可核验字体资产、截图视觉参考、文字 × 画面关系范式。三者不得混用。

浏览、筛选、调用组件；不直接把完整库铺到首页。
独立主库、扩展包、导入导出、来源登记与校验。

theme_consistency_quiet_ui.principle: Primary actions stay visible. Secondary controls move behind progressive disclosure. Daylight mode must recolor interface chrome consistently while preserving preview artwork contrast.

collapse layout secondary actions behind layout tools disclosure

typography_surface_continuity.principle: Generation prompts may preserve the visual mass of typography-heavy poster references without leaking final typesetting instructions. Exact copy, font-slot binding and SVG/HTML overlay instructions belong only to the layout brief channel.

surface_modes.complete-image-base: Render a complete image with no dead rectangular holes and no forced typography.
surface_modes.complete-editorial-base: Keep sparse editorial breathing room but make the image visually complete before overlay.
surface_modes.poster-structure-fill: Preserve visible editorial occupancy with provisional short anchors, microcopy-like bars, rules, numbering and route-appropriate graphic scaffolding.
surface_modes.integrated-short-anchor: Experimental: allow one user-supplied short anchor plus poster scaffolding; final copy is still replaced in the layout channel.

typography_surface_continuity.blank_zone_policy: Never create empty holes merely because final typography will be overlaid later. A base image must remain intentional before and after overlay.
typography_surface_continuity.exact_copy_policy: Final copy never enters the generation prompt compiler by default.

layout_studio_type_controls.principle: Accurate typography is a constrained post-layout surface. Every visible text layer may change size, weight, tracking, fill mode, color, outline and opacity without leaking these instructions back into the generation prompt compiler.

font_asset_policy.catalog_source: Official Google Fonts specimen pages and CSS API references. User-uploaded specimen screenshots remain in a separate reference-only layer.
font_asset_policy.commercial_use_rule: Catalog metadata records open-source commercial-use candidates. Font binaries are not redistributed inside this package.
font_asset_policy.offline_behavior: If official web fonts cannot load, the workbench falls back to local system font stacks.

fill_modes.outline: Hollow text rendered with a controlled outline.
fill_modes.ghost: Low-opacity filled text for background editorial occupancy.

typography_reference_governance.reference_layer: 截图、展示页与排版案例只进入视觉参考层，不进入可直接应用字体层。
typography_reference_governance.verified_asset_layer: 只有来源、授权策略与 CSS API 接入可核验的字体进入 font_assets。
typography_reference_governance.derivative_boundary: 允许适度视觉改造不等于授权清除。禁止依据截图描摹或近似复刻字形轮廓；正式输出优先调用已核验开源代理字体，或制作独立原创 lettering。
typography_reference_governance.screenshot_claim_boundary: 截图中出现“免费商用”只作为待复核线索，不作为已核验授权证据。
typography_reference_governance.relation_pattern_role: 文字 × 画面范式只提取层级、落位、避让和通道分工，不复制原图可读文字、品牌或标志。
